name: Blend With Scenery
body:
You can disguise yourself as a statue, a chest, or even a sofa.

Prerequisite(s): Master of disguise class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use Disguise to pass for an object of your approximate size, with a Disguise check modifier of -20. You apply your bonus from the master of disguise ability when you use this feat.
